Data & Insights.summary: Pakistan has suffered an estimated $40 billion in economic losses since suspending trade with India in 2019. The Pak-India Business Council states that this cutoff has caused higher import costs, supply delays, and industrial damage, prompting a call to restore commercial ties.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | What is driving the surge in GST collections from imported goods?
Data & Insights.summary: GST revenue from imported goods surged 42.2% year-on-year to ₹72,246 crore in October, significantly outpacing domestic growth of 16%. This increase was likely driven by higher import values, rupee depreciation, and a strong demand for industrial inputs.

Data & Insights.title: Can India abolish LTCG tax? SBI Research says Centre has ‘fiscal headroom’ to absorb loss, suggests alternatives
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research states that India has the financial capacity to abolish the long-term capital gains tax and absorb an annual revenue loss of up to ₹50,000 crore by fiscal year 2028. To offset this, the report suggests implementing higher exemptions, lower rates for long-term investments, and a 50% increase in the securities transaction tax.
